news.text: #Juve, Lucio's HurryAt 6 PM in #Lecce to win in Serie A after 35 days.Only 5 points won in the last 5 games. #Woltemade confirmed in tandem with #KoloMuani. #DiFra: "The upset is possible".[Front Page Corriere dello Sport]

#KOLO ARE YOU THERE?At 6 PM #Lecce-#Juve#Spalletti demands more to turn things around, especially from the Frenchman.He has the backing of the club, the coach and his teammates, he has found a partner in #Woltemade who opens up spaces: all the conditions are there for him to start making an impact again. Duel between #Alajbegovic and... #Gatti: it depends on the tactical system.[Front Page TuttoSport]

🇩🇪💪 #Spalletti is working to transform #Woltemade into a true penalty area center-forward and make him more clinical, improving his positioning in the box, his movements, his aerial game and his ability to anticipate defenders. At la Continassa, specific drills have been introduced to increase his attacking presence. Against #Lecce, he will start for the first time in Serie A.[TuttoSport via @juventusinsidernews]

🆙💪 "#Spalletti is searching for solutions to revitalize the team, working primarily on the mindset, character, grit and attitude. Indeed, the bianconeri are lacking aggressiveness, mentality and leadership. The coach is working precisely on this, trying to instill a strong mentality and the ability to take on responsibility, even in difficult moments."[Paolo Aghemo - Sky Sport via @juventusinsidernews]

🚑 #Juventus will have 8 players unavailable for the match against #Lecce.#Ekhator, #Çelik, #Conceição and Nico #González are expected to return after the November international break.For #Yildiz, #Thuram, #Locatelli and #Grabara, more time will be needed: they will return after December, in 2027.The only one who might be seen a bit sooner, around mid-December, is #Yildiz.#Spalletti will be in a total state of emergency for the upcoming matches, against #Lecce, #Genoa, #Napoli, #AZAlkmaar and #Fiorentina.[@SkySport via @TUTTOJUVE_COM - @PuebloJ]

🤐🔜 #Juve is playing for everything against #Lecce: a defeat would leave #Spalletti with 11 points after 8 matchdays, marking the worst bianconero start of the last 10 years.[Gazzetta dello Sport via @Juventus_Reborn]
